categories.main_business_segments: Minmetals New Energy Materials (Hunan) Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of high-efficiency lithium battery cathode materials. Its main products include ternary cathode materials (with self-supplied precursors), lithium iron phosphate cathode materials, lithium cobalt oxide cathode materials, and spherical nickel. The company serves the new energy vehicle power battery, energy storage systems, and consumer electronics sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies in ternary cathode materials, including high-nickel, single crystal, and high-voltage products, with international advanced technical levels. It integrates precursor and cathode material production, mastering core synthesis and preparation technologies. Production employs a demand-driven, digitally-enabled lean manufacturing system with comprehensive quality control from raw materials to finished products. The company also invests in next-generation battery materials such as lithium-rich manganese, solid-state, and semi-solid-state materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading lithium battery manufacturers such as CATL, EVE Energy, and Sunwoda. The company’s products are used primarily in new energy vehicles, energy storage systems, and consumer electronics. It has established deep strategic partnerships with top-tier battery makers and is expanding into international markets including Japan, France, and other EU countries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with headquarters and production facilities in Hunan Province. It is expanding its global footprint through strategic cooperation and joint ventures in Europe and Japan. Its supply chain and resource base extend to global mining assets in Asia, Africa, and South America via its parent group, China Minmetals.
categories.supply_chain_position: Minmetals New Energy Materials operates primarily in the midstream segment of the lithium battery supply chain, focusing on cathode material production. It also integrates upstream precursor production through its wholly-owned subsidiary, ensuring control over key raw materials. Additionally, the company is developing downstream battery recycling and reuse capabilities, aiming to form a closed-loop supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation in high-nickel, high-voltage ternary cathode materials, lithium iron phosphate, sodium-ion materials, and solid-state battery materials. It maintains a multi-tiered R&D platform with over 300 researchers and emphasizes collaboration with universities and research institutes. Strategic R&D projects include next-generation low-cobalt precursors, high-power cathode materials, and battery recycling technologies. Digitalization and lean management are key enablers for production efficiency and quality.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of lithium battery cathode materials and related precursors. The company employs a direct sales model to end customers, mainly battery manufacturers. It also receives government subsidies and grants related to technology development and environmental initiatives, which supplement operating income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in the lithium battery cathode materials industry, ranking among the top suppliers for major battery manufacturers. It competes with other Chinese cathode material producers and international suppliers. Its integration of precursor and cathode material production, strong R&D capabilities, and backing by China Minmetals provide competitive advantages in technology, resource security, and market access.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 5.54 billion, a 48.37% decrease from the previous year, primarily due to market demand shifts and raw material price declines. It incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 507.58 million. Total assets stood at RMB 12.85 billion with net assets of RMB 7.04 billion. Despite short-term financial pressure, the company continues to invest in R&D and capacity expansion, positioning for long-term growth aligned with the expanding new energy vehicle and energy storage markets.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its technological leadership in high-performance cathode materials with superior safety, energy density, and cycle life. Its integrated precursor-to-cathode production ensures stable quality and cost control. It offers a diversified product portfolio including ternary, lithium iron phosphate, and emerging sodium-ion materials, catering to varied customer needs. Backed by China Minmetals’ resource base and financial strength, it provides reliable supply and sustainable solutions, including battery recycling, to support customers’ evolving demands.
